name: ecom Tab-Ex 02 DZ2
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 02 DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 8-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 9. It has been discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ2 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T100°C Dc

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / Ex ic IIIB T100°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: CSA: Class I, Division 2, Groups A,B,C,D T5; Class I Zone 2 Group IIC T5; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: Charging and wired data (USB, POGO) and battery/SIM/SD changes only in safe locations; Ex-protective cover conductive coating must be inspected; battery Samsung EB-BT365BB only; protect from impacts, UV, static (IECEx EPS 18.0029X).

os.name: Android
os.edition: Android (version not printed; latest firmware Android 9 per earlier research)

specs.storage: 16 GB, microSD up to 256 GB (cannot be fitted or replaced after delivery)
